customManagers.description: Version of the Trivy binary that trivy-action installs, set once in an env variable of the workflows (comment above it names datasource and package).

packageRules.description: Merge all GitHub Actions updates (versions, majors and digests) three days after release, once the checks of the pull request pass. Updates without a release date (digests) are not held. GitHub auto-merge waits for the required check of the main-requires-green-build ruleset.

Trivy is the gate for every published image, so its updates wait three days like the GitHub Actions updates (a malicious Trivy release was published in March 2026) and are merged once the checks pass.

Merge patch, digest and pin updates of the Python dependencies (pyproject.toml and uv.lock) and of the Dockerfile (base image digests, uv image, syntax image) three days after release, once the checks pass. Digests have no release date and are not held. Minor and major updates stay manual.

No minor or major update of Python itself (.python-version, the python build image in the Dockerfile, requires-python in pyproject.toml). The runtime image gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian13 carries the Python of Debian 13 (3.13) and has no Python tag to bump, so the Python minor can only move together with the next distroless Debian release: change .python-version, the build stage, the `--python-version` in the Dockerfile and the runtime image in one pull request by hand. Patch and digest updates of the build image still arrive through the rule above.
